WITH trip_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    julianday(started_at) - julianday(LAG(ended_at) OVER (
      PARTITION BY bike_id
      ORDER BY started_at
    )) AS gap_days
  FROM trips
),
maintenance_gaps AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    julianday(reported_at) - julianday(LAG(completed_at) OVER (
      PARTITION BY bike_id
      ORDER BY reported_at
    )) AS gap_days
  FROM maintenance
)
SELECT
  b.bike_id,
  AVG(tg.gap_days) AS avg_trip_gap_days,
  AVG(mg.gap_days) AS avg_maintenance_gap_days
FROM bikes b
LEFT JOIN trip_gaps tg
  ON tg.bike_id = b.bike_id
LEFT JOIN maintenance_gaps mg
  ON mg.bike_id = b.bike_id
GROUP BY b.bike_id
ORDER BY b.bike_id

SELECT
  bm.model_id,
  bm.model_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id) AS bike_count,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS maintenance_job_count
FROM bike_models AS bm
LEFT JOIN bikes AS b
  ON b.model_id = bm.model_id
LEFT JOIN maintenance AS m
  ON m.bike_id = b.bike_id
GROUP BY bm.model_id, bm.model_name
ORDER BY bm.model_id

SELECT
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bikes) AS total_bikes_in_fleet,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS completed_jobs,
  1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bikes) AS completed_jobs_per_bike
FROM technicians t
LEFT JOIN maintenance m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
 AND m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.technician_id, t.technician_name
ORDER BY completed_jobs_per_bike DESC, t.technician_id ASC

WITH tech_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    MIN(date(reported_at, 'start of month')) AS first_month,
    MAX(date(reported_at, 'start of month')) AS last_month
  FROM maintenance
  WHERE technician_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY technician_id
),
months AS (
  SELECT technician_id, first_month AS month_start, last_month
  FROM tech_bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT technician_id, date(month_start, '+1 month'), last_month
  FROM months
  WHERE month_start < last_month
),
monthly_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    date(reported_at, 'start of month') AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS jobs_reported
  FROM maintenance
  WHERE technician_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY technician_id, date(reported_at, 'start of month')
)
SELECT
  m.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  strftime('%Y-%m', m.month_start) AS month,
  COALESCE(j.jobs_reported, 0) AS jobs_reported,
  SUM(COALESCE(j.jobs_reported, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY m.technician_id
    ORDER BY m.month_start
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_jobs_reported
FROM months m
JOIN technicians t
  ON t.technician_id = m.technician_id
LEFT JOIN monthly_jobs j
  ON j.technician_id = m.technician_id
 AND j.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.technician_id, m.month_start

SELECT member_id, trip_count
FROM (
  SELECT m.member_id,
         COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(t.trip_id) ASC) AS rnk
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id
)
WHERE rnk = 1

SELECT
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  strftime('%Y-%m', m.reported_at) AS year_month,
  SUM(m.cost_cents) AS monthly_maintenance_cost_cents,
  SUM(SUM(m.cost_cents)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.technician_id
    ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', m.reported_at)
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_maintenance_cost_cents
FROM technicians AS t
JOIN maintenance AS m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
GROUP BY
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  strftime('%Y-%m', m.reported_at)
ORDER BY
  t.technician_id,
  year_month

SELECT
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT wd.day) AS weather_record_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.technician_id) AS technician_count,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.technician_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT wd.day), 0),
    6
  ) AS technician_to_weather_day_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT wd.day) = 0 THEN 'no_weather_data'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.technician_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT wd.day) >= 0.020 THEN 'high'
    WHEN 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.technician_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT wd.day) >= 0.010 THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS density_label
FROM boroughs b
LEFT JOIN weather_daily wd
  ON wd.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN technicians t
  ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
ORDER BY b.borough_id
